query: Where do I file a consumer complaint for a dispute worth Rs. 15 Lakhs against a car dealer in Noida?

model_output.summary: For your consumer dispute of Rs. 15 Lakhs against a car dealer in Noida, you can file a complaint before the District Consumer Commission. Since the amount is up to Rs. 50 Lakhs, the District Commission has the proper pecuniary jurisdiction. You can file this complaint online through the e-Daakhil portal or in person within two years from when the issue started.
facts_extracted: Dispute is against a car dealer in Noida.

options.title: File Consumer Complaint Online via e-Daakhil
options.description: Submit your complaint online along with purchase receipts and documents through the official e-Daakhil portal.
cons: Requires scanning all documents and proper online submission

options.title: File Consumer Complaint in Person or by Post
options.description: Submit your written complaint directly to the District Consumer Commission having jurisdiction where you reside or where the dealer operates.
pros: Direct interaction with the filing registry

citations.relevance: Establishes that the District Consumer Commission has jurisdiction for disputes where the value does not exceed Rs. 50 Lakhs.
Explains the manner of filing a complaint electronically or physically.
Mandates that a complaint must be filed within two years from the date the cause of action arose.

missing_info: Date when the cause of action arose (to verify the 2-year limitation period)
